notes.title: Lost Squad Dev Media Update #2 - "Lost Squad Procedural Sky Rendering with Source Engine" - Part One
notes.content:
Hello our Dear friends. Thanks for being with us and waiting Lost Squad, we much appreciate it!

Today, I am going to share with you our recent dev-media update we just published on IndieDB/ModDB:

http://www.moddb.com/games/lost-squad/news/lost-squad-winter-2016-update-day-two-procedural-sky-rendering-with-source

It is about what we are working on currently - making better and more next-gen sky.

Enjoy and have a nice day!
